issues.what: The 'macro into a lit lamp' move is almost entirely a slow sideways slide. The lamp graphic barely grows across 5 s, so the camera never actually pushes into the lens.
issues.fix: Add a slow eased dolly-in toward the lens (about 15–25% scale growth) on top of the lateral drift

issues.what: The tilt/crane from the arch down to the tread is fast for a macro move, peaking at about a third of the frame height per second. The arch, where the drips fall, leaves frame by about 17 s, so the drips get little screen time.
issues.fix: Slow the descent and hold on the arch longer before easing down to the tread

issues.what: The close pass reaches cruise speed within about 0.4 s of the cut, so the ease-in is very short compared with the eased ending
issues.fix: Lengthen the ease-in to about 0.8–1 s or start the move pre-rolled at a gentler speed

issues.what: The seam has no jump, and 44.97 s matches 0.00 s. But the camera eases to a full stop and eases out again, so it sits near-static for about 2 s across the loop and reads as a pause.
issues.fix: Shorten the settle at the end of return and the ease-out at the start of arrival so the push keeps some motion through the seam
